units.source_text: 过去参观金阁的，只有稀稀拉拉的几个空军服或作业服或扎腿劳动服的游客。

en.t: In the past, the only people who came to visit the Golden Pavilion were a few scattered tourists in air force uniforms, work clothes, or gaitered laborers' outfits.

units.source_text: 如今如今占领军来了，俗世的淫乱风俗蜂拥到了金阁的周围。

en.t: Now that the occupation forces had arrived, the lewd customs of the secular world came swarming around the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 另一方面，上供茶的习惯也恢复了，

en.t: On the other hand, the custom of offering tea had also been restored,

units.source_text: 妇女们穿上收藏多年的华丽衣裳，登上金阁来了。

en.t: and women put on the splendid clothes they had kept stored away for many years and came up to the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 映在她们眼帘里的我们、我们穿着僧衣的身影．同她们形成了鲜明的对照，

en.t: We, as we appeared in their eyes, our figures dressed in monks' robes, formed a striking contrast with them,

units.source_text: 我们简直像是扮演着怪癖的僧侣的角色。

en.t: as if we were simply playing the roles of eccentric monks.

units.source_text: 就犹如居民特地恪守珍奇的旧习俗，是为了给前来参观的人提供珍奇的地方风俗一样……

en.t: It was as though the residents deliberately preserved rare old customs in order to offer visitors an exotic local spectacle...

units.source_text: 特别是美国兵们肆无忌惮地拉扯我的僧衣袖子，笑个不停。

en.t: The American soldiers in particular would brazenly tug at the sleeves of my monk's robe and laugh without stopping.

units.source_text: 或者为拍纪念照，掏出少许钱来让我们租借给他们僧衣。

en.t: Or, in order to take souvenir photographs, they would take out a little money and get us to rent them our monks' robes.

units.source_text: 有时候，鹤川和我被拉差，充当蹩脚的英语向导，以代替不会英语的导游，所以看见了这种情景。

en.t: At times Tsurukawa and I were dragged in to serve as clumsy English-speaking guides in place of guides who knew no English, and so we witnessed scenes like this.
